newsitem.title: USA: No date, acre target new US CRP signup--Glickman.
newsitem.headline: No date, acre target new US CRP signup--Glickman.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Thursday no date or acreage target had been set yet for a Conservation Reserve Program signup to be held later this year.
"I'm reserving judgement on all those things," Glickman told reporters, until the Agriculture Department rules on offers submitted in March to put land in the CRP.

Farmers offered 25.6 million acres. USDA has said it might accept up to 19 million acres but has no target. Glickman, in a letter to senators last week, said there would be another signup later this year.
